name: PictoQuest
summary:
PictoQuest helps you examine rock art where you stand. Look at a surface through Quest 3 or Quest 3S and switch among live color-enhancement recipes designed to make subtle pigment differences easier to see. Adjust strength, choose a central sampling area, or lock an enhancement while you look around.

Use Spotlight to compare an enhanced area with the surrounding original colors. Move or hide the menu so it stays out of your way. Save enhanced JPEG photos and record 2D video after approving Quest's capture
